===Voting Confessionals===
{{confessional|tovuto|(''voting against Brady'') What a freaking mess. I'm in a lot of trouble if this doesn't go my way tonight.|Mike Pinsky|Mike|S51 mike t.png}}
{{confessional|tovuto|(''voting against Eric'') This merge thing, brodie. Unfortunately, the guy's name who I wanted to write down tonight is wearing the necklace.|Brady Booker|Brady|S51 brady t.png}}
{{confessional|tovuto|(''voting against Brady'') Don't ever rat out when I'm trying to help you and gain your trust. You crossed the vampire: time to get bit.|Eric Macksoud|Eric|S51 eric t.png}}
===Final Words===
{{Confessional|none|Tonight was a bummer and I feel like I left a lot out on the table, you know. The people who said they were with me weren't and millions of dollars are great motivators. Um, I played ''Survivor'' like I wrestle in the ring. I played hard and I played with passion, maybe sometimes too much passion, you know. Definitely made some mistakes, had fun doing it. Very thankful to be a part of it.|Brady Booker|Brady|S51 brady bw.png}}
